title: Robots Live!
description: A live robot combat show with fighting machines armed with flippers and axes, presented by people from the BBC's Robot Wars. VIP tickets include meeting the engineers and photos with the robots.

title: Creepy Creatures
description: Meet snakes, spiders and toads up close for Halloween and find out about their role in nature and where they live in the wild.

title: Party Roo “Through the Years” Disco
description: A kids' disco mixing music from different decades with classic party games and today's hits, in a space at the Spitfire Cafe. Part of the Mitchell Arts Centre's 70th-birthday Time Travel Festival. Spaces are limited.

title: Halloween Blood Pool Party
description: The pool is dyed red for a Halloween family swim, with spooky decorations, games, tricks and treats, and prizes for the best fancy dress. Book by phone or email.
